# Banking MCP connectors

5 banking connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

Each connector's page lists its tools with their parameters and how to start without code; the guide links open the setup guide on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All banking connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/banking](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/banking).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Brex](connectors/brex.md) | Let your AI read your Brex account: cards, card and business account transactions, statements, expenses, budgets, spend limits, vendors, users and trips. | 28 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/brex-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-brex-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-brex-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-brex-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-brex-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-brex-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-brex-to-muse) |
| [Mercury](connectors/mercury.md) | Let your AI read your Mercury business banking: accounts and balances, transactions, cards, statements, recipients, Treasury, credit and users. | 22 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/mercury-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mercury-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mercury-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mercury-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mercury-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mercury-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mercury-to-muse) |
| [Ramp](connectors/ramp.md) | Let your AI read your Ramp account: cards, funds and spend limits, transactions, reimbursements, bills, vendors, receipts, statements, GL accounts and users. | 31 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/ramp-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ramp-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ramp-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ramp-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ramp-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ramp-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ramp-to-muse) |
| [Revolut Business](connectors/revolut-business.md) | Read your Revolut Business accounts from any AI agent: balances, bank details, transactions, counterparties, expenses and exchange rates. | 10 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/revolut-business-to-mcp) |
| [Wise (formerly TransferWise)](connectors/wise.md) | Manage international money transfers via the Wise Platform API: list personal and business profiles, view balances, create quotes, list past transfers. | 4 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/wise-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-wise-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-wise-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-wise-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-wise-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-wise-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-wise-to-muse) |
